title: Page 3
content_zh:
他来救她了！她就知道他会来救她的，他总是在她需要的时候出现，不管他显得多么不耐烦，可是当她有困难的时候，他就会出现。
神奇！真的太神奇了！不是吗？
他就像是她专属的超人。
天！她又爱他爱得更深了！
然而当她想上前紧紧拥抱住他，诉说她有多么感谢、多么感动的时候，他给了她一记冷冷的白眼，转身走了。
她追上去，虽然情况还是没有改变，她还是只能追逐着他的背影，但是现在她的心情不一样了。
她告诉自己他是关心她的，他只是嘴硬，表现得冷漠其实不过是害羞。
乐得快要飞上天，她追着他的脚步也轻快起来……
叶咏欢醒来的时候嘴角还带着笑，砰砰砰的敲门声在她的耳边响着—原来这就是让她从美梦中醒来的原因。
她有些哀怨的嘟起嘴。好久没有作这么好的梦了啊！
梦到苏大哥不说，梦到的还是以前最美好的一段时光。天啊！她真的好想好想他呵！
第1章(2)
「欢欢，妳还在磨蹭什么？客人来了。」
叶咏欢猛的从床上跳起来。
对了、对了！她知道为什么自己会作那样的梦了，今天苏大哥会来！爸爸昨天跟她讲这个好消息时，她高兴得一整晚都睡不着，所以刚刚等着等着才会不小心睡着。
「我、我等一下就下去！」
匆匆忙忙的从床上爬起来，她跑到镜子前，梳着头发的手还有些颤抖。她太紧张了，心跳得好快。
镜子里反射出来的女孩有张红扑扑的脸蛋，一双眼睛亮晶晶的闪着期待光芒。
不知道苏大哥看到现在的她会有什么感觉？她知道自己的模样不差，一直以来也有很多男生追求，可是她从来不曾跟任何人交往过，因为她的心里一直有着一个人，那个人占据了最深、最重要的位置。
她相信自己跟苏大哥一定会再见面的，不知道为什么，她就是有这种感觉。果然，她的直觉是对的。

镜子里的人露出傻乎乎的笑容……
欸，不对！她现在没有空在这边作白日梦了，苏大哥就在楼下！
尖叫一声，她赶快把头发梳一梳，慌张的跑出房间。
「欢欢，妳怎么这么慢才下来，妳不是一直说很想见妳的苏大哥吗？」
叶咏欢无法回答父亲的问题，事实上，她根本连呼吸都快有困难了。
虽然她脑子里已经把苏大哥的脸孔模样深深
没错，那轮廓身形是她熟悉的，可是那双彷佛可以把人冻结的眼睛，还有比以前壮硕的身体，像是要从那一身深色手工西装里爆发出骇人的力量。
现在的苏大哥……让人有点害怕……不敢接近……
在她傻愣愣看着他的同时，苏劲沧也将视线射向她。
这家伙一点长进也没有。
人家不是说女大十八变吗？可她那像洋娃娃一样蓬松卷曲的头发，让人很想狠狠捏一捏的柔软脸颊，还有看到他时的一脸呆样，一点都没变。
看她的样子就知道她是一直生活在温室里的小花，恐怕是一点都不知道现实的残酷是怎么回事吧？咏欢，永欢，她的父母对她唯一的期待就是永远欢乐吧？还真是轻松写意呢！
天真无邪、无忧无虑的让人不由得生恨……
「好久不见。」苏劲沧微微弯起嘴角，看着她。
他在微笑，可是那笑意并没有进到他的眼眸当中。
叶咏欢的脸整个红了起来。虽然跟她记忆中的苏大哥差别很大，可是以前要看他一个微笑有多难，所以当他用着那张让她魂牵梦萦的脸和颜悦色的对她说话时，她的心还是不受控制的狂跳如擂鼓。
「苏大哥……」
「怎么这么生疏呢？欢欢，妳不是一直念念不忘妳的苏大哥吗？」
父亲的调笑让叶咏欢的脸更红，可是她没有反驳，因为那是事实。
「我看妳就跟妳苏大哥好好聊聊，我去看菜好了没有。」

听妻子这么说，叶金富也连忙附和。「我也去看看。」
客厅里霎时只剩下叶咏欢和苏劲沧。
无庸置疑，那对夫妇是想要给两人制造独处的机会，不过这种手法未免也太不高明了。苏劲沧在心里冷笑。
没有看出他冷凝的双眼里透出的讥讽，叶咏欢的视线无法从他的身上移开，像是一个饥渴许久的沙漠旅人，她想好好仔细的看看心中最重要的人的变化。
「好渴，有东西可以喝吗？」
他的话让她醒过来似的跳起来。
「噢！有，当然有。苏大哥你要喝什么？」
她不禁懊恼自己怎么那么不体贴、不懂礼貌，别说他是苏大哥了，把客人晾在一旁，也不知道要准备饮料本来就是不对的事情。
「咖啡好了。」
「咖、咖啡？」她脑袋停了一下，片刻才回过神来。「好，你等一下。」
她匆匆忙忙跑到厨房，叶母和帮佣正忙着张罗晚餐，没空帮她泡咖啡。她像无头苍蝇一样忙着把咖啡机拿出来，可问题是她根本不会煮，最后只好拿出速溶咖啡包……
看到苏劲沧喝下第一口咖啡后皱起的眉头，她的心就往下沉。
「对、对不起，我不会煮咖啡，只能拿冲泡的。」
「没关系。」他浅浅的笑。「我早该知道的，妳还是没什么长进嘛，跟以前一样笨笨的，什么都不会。」
「啊？」
叶咏欢愣住。
她没听错吧？苏大哥怎么会这样讲？
现在她才看清楚他眼底满满的嘲弄，刚刚爸妈在场时的客气礼貌已荡然无存，跟她独处的他完全判若两人。
「妳大学毕业了吧？现在在做什么？」
「呃……没做什么。」面对他锐利如刀的眼睛，她畏缩了。

「是吗？真好命呢！」
她手足无措的站着，眼前这个苏大哥不是她所熟悉的。
以前他也爱欺负她，可是最后往往还是会心软，她可以感觉到他不耐烦的表情下其实藏着对她的关心。但现在的他似乎浑身充满尖刺，更复杂，也更可怕……
尴尬的沉默在两人间蔓延，叶咏欢想着自己似乎该说点什么。「那、那苏大哥现在在做什么呢？」
「我自己创业，开了公司。不会吧？妳爸没跟妳提？」
「没有。不过，苏大哥真的好厉害，不论做什么事情都那么棒。」
苏劲沧耸耸肩没说什么。
叶咏欢咽了口口水，跟这样的他在一起让她真的很紧张。
「苏大哥，你十年前怎么不说一声就搬走了？我、我一直都很想你。」
「我家发生什么事妳不知道？」
「我知道，可是你应该留下来，我跟爸妈提过了，你那时突然遇到那样的事情，我们应该照顾你，让你住我们家，爸爸也同意了。」
苏劲沧挑眉，然后像听到什么好笑的事一样仰头大笑起来。
叶金富竟然有脸跟自己的女儿撒这样的大谎，在他家最困难时，第一个背弃他们的不就是他吗？
她更迷惑了。刚刚她讲的话有哪里很好笑吗？她不懂，现在这个苏大哥，她不懂。
「妳爸爸真的把妳保护得很好对不对？妳真的什么都不知道对不对？」
「什么？」她心缩了下，他的话让她不安。
「算了，无所谓了，不知道也好，什么都不知道的人最幸福。」
她正想要细问到底他是什么意思，叶母的声音忽然闯入。
「可以吃饭了喔，你们有什么话边吃边聊吧！」
content_en:
He's come to save her! She knew he would come to save her. He would always appear when she needed her. No matter how impatient he seemed, he would appear when she was in trouble.
magic! It's really amazing! Isn't it?
He was like her very own Superman.
sky! She loves him even more deeply!
However, when she wanted to step forward and hug him tightly, telling her how grateful and touched she was, he gave her a cold eye roll and turned around and left.
She chased after him. Although the situation had not changed, she could only chase his back, but now her mood was different.
She told herself that he cared about her, that he was just being tough and acting cold was actually just shyness.
She was so happy that she almost flew into the sky, and her footsteps became brisk as she chased him...
Ye Yonghuan still had a smile on her face when she woke up, and the banging on the door was ringing in her ears - it turned out that this was what woke her up from her sweet dream.
She pouted sadly. I haven’t had such a good dream for a long time!
Not only did I dream about Brother Su, I dreamed about the best time in the past. Oh my God! She really misses him so much!
Chapter 1(2)
"Huanhuan, what are you still dawdling about? The guests are here."
Ye Yonghuan jumped up from the bed.
Right, right! She knew why she had such a dream. Brother Su will come today! When her father told her the good news yesterday, she was so happy that she couldn't sleep all night, so she accidentally fell asleep while waiting.
"I-I'll be down in a moment!"
She hurriedly got up from the bed and ran to the mirror, her hands combing her hair still trembling. She was so nervous and her heart was beating so fast.
The girl reflected in the mirror had a rosy face and a pair of bright eyes shining with anticipation.
I wonder how Brother Su will feel when he sees her now? She knew that her appearance was not bad, and she had been pursued by many boys, but she had never dated anyone because there was always one person in her heart, and that person occupied the deepest and most important position.
She believed that she and Brother Su would definitely meet again. She didn't know why, but she just felt this way. Sure enough, her intuition was right.
The person in the mirror shows a silly smile...
Oh, no! She has no time to daydream here now, Brother Su is downstairs!
With a scream, she quickly combed her hair and ran out of the room in a panic.
"Huanhuan, why are you taking so long to come down? Didn't you always say that you really want to see your brother Su?"
Ye Yonghuan couldn't answer her father's question. In fact, she almost had difficulty breathing.
Although she already had Brother Su’s face deeply etched in her mind,
Yes, that silhouette was familiar to her, but those eyes that seemed to freeze people, and the body that was stronger than before, seemed to burst out with terrifying power from the dark handmade suit.
The current Brother Su... makes people a little scared... and dare not approach him...
While she was looking at him blankly, Su Jincang also directed his gaze towards her.
This guy has made no progress at all.
Aren’t they saying that women are changing in their eighteenth year? But her doll-like fluffy and curly hair, her soft cheeks that made people want to pinch them hard, and the dumb look on her face when she saw him, hadn't changed at all.
Looking at her appearance, you can tell that she is just a little flower who has been living in a greenhouse. I am afraid she has no idea about the cruelty of reality, right? Yong Huan, Yong Huan, her parents’ only expectation for her is to be happy forever, right? It’s really relaxing and freehand!
It’s so innocent and carefree that people can’t help but hate it…
"Long time no see." Su Jincang slightly curved the corners of his mouth and looked at her.
He was smiling, but the smile did not enter his eyes.
Ye Yonghuan's face turned red. Although it is different from the Brother Su she remembers,No matter how big it was, it was hard to see him smile in the past, so when he spoke to her kindly with that face that haunted her, her heart was still beating like a drum uncontrollably.
"Brother Su..."
"Why are you so unfamiliar? Huanhuan, haven't you always missed your brother Su?"
Her father's teasing made Ye Yonghuan blush even more, but she didn't refute it because it was the truth.
"I think you should have a good chat with your brother Su, and I'll go see if the food is ready."
After hearing what his wife said, Ye Jinfu quickly agreed. "I'll go take a look too."
Suddenly, only Ye Yonghuan and Su Jincang were left in the living room.
There is no doubt that the couple wanted to create an opportunity for the two of them to be alone, but this method was too cunning. Su Jincang sneered in his heart.
Not seeing the sarcasm in his cold eyes, Ye Yonghuan couldn't take her eyes away from him, like a desert traveler who had been thirsty for a long time. She wanted to take a closer look at the changes in the most important person in her heart.
"I'm so thirsty. Is there anything I can drink?"
His words made her jump as if awake.
"Oh! Yes, of course. Brother Su, what do you want to drink?"
She couldn't help but feel annoyed about why she was so inconsiderate and impolite. Not to mention that he was Brother Su, leaving the guests aside and not knowing that it was wrong to prepare drinks.
"The coffee is ready."
"C-coffee?" Her head paused for a moment before she came back to her senses. "Okay, wait a moment."
She hurried to the kitchen. Ye's mother and the helper were busy preparing dinner and had no time to make coffee for her. She was busy taking out the coffee machine like a headless fly, but the problem was that she couldn't make it at all, so she had to take out the instant coffee bags...
Seeing Su Jincang's frown after taking the first sip of coffee, her heart sank.
"Yeah, I'm sorry, I can't make coffee, I can only take brewed coffee."
"It's okay." He smiled lightly. "I should have known better. You still haven't made any progress. You are just as stupid as before and you don't know anything."
"Huh?"
Ye Yonghuan was stunned.
Did she hear it correctly? How could Brother Su say this?
Only now did she see clearly the mockery in his eyes. The politeness and politeness he had shown when his parents were present were gone. He was completely different from when he was alone with her.
"Have you graduated from college? What are you doing now?"
"Uh... didn't do anything." Facing his sharp eyes, she flinched.
"Really? What a blessing!"
She stood at a loss. The Brother Su in front of her was not familiar to her.
He used to love to bully her, but he would always relent in the end. She could feel that his impatient expression actually concealed his concern for her. But now he seems to be full of spikes, more complicated and more terrifying...
An awkward silence spread between the two of them, and Ye Yonghuan thought about what he should say. "Then, what is Brother Su doing now?"
"I started my own business and opened a company. Isn't that right? Your dad didn't mention it to you?"
"No. However, Brother Su is really awesome, no matter what he does, he is so good."
Su Jincang shrugged and said nothing.
Ye Yonghuan swallowed, being with him like this made her really nervous.
"Brother Su, why did you move away ten years ago without saying a word? I, I have always missed you."
"You don't know what happened to my family?"
"I know, but you should stay. I mentioned it to my parents. If you suddenly encountered something like that, we should take care of you and let you live in our house. Dad also agreed."
Su Jincang raised his eyebrows, then threw his head back and laughed as if he heard something funny.
Ye Jinfu actually had the nerve to tell such a big lie to his daughter. When his family was in the most difficult time, wasn't he the one who turned his back on them first?
She was even more confused. Is there anything funny about what she just said? She doesn't understand, nowShe doesn't understand this Brother Su.
"Your father really protects you very well, right? You really don't know anything, right?"
"What?" She flinched, his words making her uneasy.
"Forget it, it doesn't matter. It doesn't matter if you don't know. People who don't know anything are the happiest."
Just as she was about to ask what he meant, Ye Mu's voice suddenly broke in.
"It's time to eat. If you have anything to say, let's talk while eating!"
